campaigns.headline: Pensacola PCS checklist
campaigns.primaryText: A Gulf Coast PCS move brings a lot of deadlines. Start with a practical 60/30/7-day checklist for housing, household goods, schools and arrival planning. Read it free, then request a planning call if you need help with the home search. Gregg Costin, REALTOR® | Levin Rinke Realty. Equal Housing Opportunity.
campaigns.creativeStatus: Final platform image/crop selection still pending. Local share card is available; the preview currently uses existing profile media. Do not launch before review.
campaigns.testHypothesis: A practical checklist creates more useful planning conversations than a generic Realtor introduction.
campaigns.facebookOrganic: A PCS checklist is easier to use when it tells you what to do next. This guide breaks planning into 60 days, 30 days and the last week: housing, household goods, schools and arrival details. Save it for your move, or send it to someone with orders. Gregg Costin, REALTOR® | Levin Rinke Realty.
campaigns.instagramCaption: A Gulf Coast PCS move has enough moving parts. Save a simple 60/30/7-day plan for housing, household goods, schools and arrival. The free PCS checklist is at PensacolaMilitaryHousing.com through my profile link. Need help with the home search? Request a planning call. Gregg Costin, REALTOR® | Levin Rinke Realty.
campaigns.reelScript: Before a PCS move, put three dates on your calendar: sixty days, thirty days and the final week. Use each checkpoint to confirm the next housing, household-goods, school and arrival tasks. I have a free printable Pensacola PCS checklist you can work through. Open the military housing link in my profile and start with the next deadline.

campaigns.headline: What will you bring to closing?
campaigns.primaryText: The down payment is only one part of cash to close. This Florida buyer guide walks through state charges, title costs, insurance, escrow, deposits and credits using a clearly labeled $350,000 purchase example. Use the worksheet with your own Loan Estimate and written quotes. Gregg Costin, REALTOR® | Levin Rinke Realty. Equal Housing Opportunity.
campaigns.creativeStatus: Reviewed 1200x630 share card; confirm mobile ad crop at publication.
campaigns.testHypothesis: An itemized cash-to-close worksheet attracts buyers seeking a concrete plan.
campaigns.facebookOrganic: Before wiring money for a home purchase, separate three numbers: the down payment, closing costs and the remaining cash to close. This guide works through a $350,000 hypothetical purchase and shows where deposits and approved credits fit. Replace the example's allowances with your written quotes. Save the worksheet for your Loan Estimate review. Gregg Costin, REALTOR® | Levin Rinke Realty.
campaigns.instagramCaption: The down payment is not the whole cash-to-close number. Save this checklist: loan and title fees; state charges; insurance and escrow; deposits already paid; approved credits. The full Florida closing-cost worksheet is in the buyer guides at GreggCostin.com through my profile link. The example is hypothetical; use your own written quotes. Gregg Costin, REALTOR® | Levin Rinke Realty.
campaigns.reelScript: A down payment and cash to close are different numbers. Start with your down payment. Add the charges and prepaid amounts on your Loan Estimate. Then account for deposits already paid and any permitted credits. I put a worked Florida example and a checklist in the buyer guides at GreggCostin.com. Use your own written quotes to make it a plan for your purchase.
